model: Animated Airblown inflatable shipped with manual code AB-2-E (2021)
notes: The manual prints no model number: these parts apply to inflatables shipped with Gemmy's Animated Airblown manual AB-2-E (2021), which lists 40 item numbers. The 2019 AB-2-E, the 2021 AB-7-E and the 227163-E manuals print the same 5 A 125 V plug fuse and C7 7 W lamp.

gaps: No model number is printed; the product is identified by its manual code, AB-2-E, and Lowe's document 45417289.
The fan's own rating is not printed, so no voltage is set on it; the manual gives 120 V 60 Hz for the product.
The lamp count is not printed (the manual speaks of 'either lamp holder contact'), so no quantity is set.
No adapter and no separate animation motor are named; the manual's 'motor' mentions are in troubleshooting and the cold-weather note, so no motor part is claimed.
Production years are not stated; the manual is copyright 2021.
method: Gemmy Animated Airblown manual, code AB-2-E, (c)2021 Gemmy Industries, Lowe's-hosted PDF, 3 pages: 120 V 60 Hz and lamp caution on page 1, lamp and fuse replacement on page 2 (page image checked), plug-in step on page 3.
Other manuals read only for the same-ratings sentence in the notes: AB-2-E (c)2019 (Lowe's PDF 11360042), AB-7-E (c)2021 (Lowe's PDF 45417279) and 227163-E (c)2021 (Home Depot-hosted PDF).
Lowe's and Home Depot product pages turned up no model number tied to document 45417289.

comps.spec: Electric fan that keeps the inflatable inflated; the manual calls it the electric fan and says to keep it and the cord away from direct water
Fuse in the attachment plug, behind a sliding access cover on top; the manual says to replace it only with a 5 A max, 125 V fuse, which it says is provided with the product
comps.loc: Attachment plug, under the cover on top

comps.spec: C7 candelabra-base lamp, 7 W max, 120 V, UL classified (replacement lamps are not included); reached by opening the zipper opening and pushing aside the locking tabs of the light cover
comps.loc: Under the light cover on the inflatable

comps.spec: Fabric body of the inflatable; the manual says rips can be sewn by hand or taped with clear packing tape
